hints.title: Coordinate Tracking
hints.text: Start at origin (0, 0) and record each visited coordinate point in a set.

hints.title: Move Delta Updates
hints.text: N increments y, S decrements y, E increments x, W decrements x.

hints.title: Collision Check
hints.text: After every step, check if the current (x, y) coordinate already exists in the set. If so, path crosses itself.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing every new point against all previous points in an array takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set lookups enable O(1) expected collision checks per step, totaling O(N) time and space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate initializes visited set with origin (0, 0) and executes incremental coordinate updates cleanly.
complexity.notes: Initial position (0, 0) must be included before moves begin.
